finish: Sing and play 3 new songs, start to finish

skills.title: Barre chords
skills.desc: Fret full barre chords such as F and B minor with clear notes.
quests: Hold an E shape barre chord for 30 seconds with all strings ringing
Practice the F chord with a 10 minute daily drill for a week
Move an E shape barre up the neck through five positions

videos.title: F Barre Chord Exercise for Acoustic Guitar
How To Have Cleaner & Buzz Free Barre Chords - Tips for Beginners!

skills.title: Faster chord changes
skills.desc: Change between chords smoothly at a steady tempo.
quests: Change G to C to D at 60 BPM without stopping for a full minute
Use anchor fingers to keep one finger in place between chords
Play a four chord loop at 90 BPM for two minutes

videos.title: 4 Chord Switching Drills That Actually Work
Get FASTER Chord Changes On Guitar!

skills.title: Varied strum patterns
skills.desc: Use palm muting and accents to play a wider range of rhythms.
quests: Add palm muting to a verse without stopping the groove
Play a reggae or folk strum with accents on the offbeat
Learn two songs that each use a different strum pattern

skills.title: Learning songs by ear
skills.desc: Pick out chord progressions from a recording without a chart.
quests: Identify the chords of one song by listening and checking with a tuner
Find the key of a song by playing along to its bass line
Write down the chord progression of three songs from memory

skills.title: Capo and keys
skills.desc: Use a capo and transpose songs to fit your voice.
quests: Transpose one song up two frets with a capo and check the chords
Find the capo position that fits a singer's range in a song
Play the same progression in three different keys

skills.title: Singing while playing
skills.desc: Keep a steady strum and sing the melody at the same time.
quests: Sing a verse with a simple strum pattern at slow tempo
Sing the chorus of a song while playing the chords without stopping
Record a take of singing and playing and listen back for timing

skills.title: Fingerpicking patterns
skills.desc: Play arpeggio and Travis style picking under a melody line.
quests: Play a basic Travis pattern on a four chord loop
Alternate thumb bass with two fingers on the top strings
Pick a verse of a folk song with steady thumb timing

skills.title: Song structure and memory
skills.desc: Memorize full song structures so you can play start to finish.
quests: Map the intro, verse, chorus and bridge of one song on paper
Play a full song from memory without looking at chords
Practice a song's transitions between sections at tempo

skills.title: Sing and play 3 new songs, start to finish
skills.desc: Sing and play three new songs start to finish, keeping each one steady and in key.
quests: Pick three new songs in keys that suit your voice and learn their chords
Run each song start to finish with singing and playing at tempo
Play all three songs in one session with no stops or restarts
